intro.h2: Custom Web Design Wolverhampton Businesses Can Grow With
paras: DigiRanx Pro offers custom web design Wolverhampton businesses can rely on when a template simply will not do. We start every project from a blank canvas, shaped around your brand, your customers and the goals you set for the site. Nothing is recycled from another client. Your website is designed to explain what you do, show why you are different and guide visitors towards a call, an enquiry or a sale.

Our process is built so you never have to imagine the finished result. We agree the page structure in wireframes first, then add colour, type and imagery once the layout makes sense. Before any code is written, you review a clickable prototype on your own phone and laptop. You can tap through menus, test buttons and share it with colleagues, so feedback is based on something real rather than a static image.

As a new studio based at Dunstall Hill in Wolverhampton, we work closely with each client and keep communication simple. You speak to the people designing your pages, not a call centre. We support businesses across Wolverhampton, Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley and Telford, and work remotely with companies across the wider UK. Whether you run a trade business, a clinic, a shop or a professional service, the design is planned around how your customers actually decide.

Good website design is more than a nice homepage. Every layout we create is conversion-led, with clear calls to action, readable text and a structure that search engines understand. At handover you receive a design system of reusable styles, so new pages stay consistent as your business grows. If you also need the site built, our Web Development service picks up the approved designs, so one team takes the project from first sketch to launch.

why.h2: Why Choose DigiRanx Pro for Your Website Design
why.lead: Choosing a web designer is a big decision for any business. Here is what you can expect when you work with our Wolverhampton team on a custom website.

points.d: We never start with a theme and swap the logo. Each layout is drawn from scratch around your brand and your customers, so your website looks like your business and gives visitors a reason to remember you over competitors.

points.t: You See It Before It Is Built
points.d: Wireframes and a clickable prototype let you review the structure and the visuals on real devices. Changes are cheap and quick at this stage, which means fewer surprises later and a smoother build once the design is signed off.

Our office is in Wolverhampton and our hours run from 8am to 10pm on weekdays. You can call, email or arrange a meeting, and you always deal directly with the people working on your design rather than an account middleman.

Our custom web design packages are priced up front, from a four-page Starter design to a full design system. You know what is included, how many revision rounds you get and what you will pay before any work begins.

benefits.h2: Benefits of a Custom Designed Website
benefits.lead: A bespoke website design gives you control over how your business is presented online. These are the practical benefits our clients receive.

items.t: A Website That Matches Your Brand
items.d: Your colours, typography and imagery are applied consistently on every page. The result feels like a natural extension of your shopfront, vans, leaflets and social profiles, which helps people recognise and trust your business straight away.

Every page has a clear purpose and a clear next step. We place calls to action, contact details and key information where visitors expect to find them, making it easier for them to get in touch or buy.

Most local searches happen on a phone, so every package includes mobile layouts. Higher tiers add tablet designs too. Visitors get a comfortable experience on any screen, without pinching, zooming or hunting for the menu.

A clean page structure, sensible headings and fast, focused layouts make it easier for Google to understand your site. That gives your local SEO work in Wolverhampton and the West Midlands a stronger foundation to build on.
The design system we hand over contains reusable styles and components. When you add a new service page or landing page later, it slots in neatly and looks like it has always been part of the site.

Because you approve wireframes and a working prototype first, the final website matches what you agreed. There is no awkward moment at launch where the live site looks different from what you expected.

steps.lead: Every project follows the same clear sequence, so you always know what is happening now and what comes next.

items.d: We start with a conversation about your business, your customers and what makes you different. We look at competitor sites and examples you like, then agree goals for the website and the pages it needs.
Next we sketch each key page in simple grey boxes. This fixes the order of content, the navigation and the calls to action before any visual styling, so we agree how the site works first.

With the structure approved, we apply your brand colours, typography and imagery. We design the homepage first, gather your feedback, then roll the agreed style out across the inner pages and mobile layouts.
You receive a clickable prototype to test on your own phone and laptop. We collect your comments and work through the revision rounds included in your package until every page is ready to sign off.

Finally we package the approved designs, assets and reusable styles for build. If our development team is building the site, the handover is seamless. If you use another developer, they receive organised, ready-to-use files.

faqs.q: How Much Does Custom Web Design Cost?
faqs.a: Our Starter package is £499 for a custom homepage and three inner page designs with mobile versions. Business is £999 for up to ten page designs with a clickable prototype. Premium is £1,999 for unlimited page designs and a full component library. All prices are one-off fees in GBP, excluding VAT.

faqs.q: Do You Also Build the Website?
faqs.a: Yes. Most clients pair custom web design with our Web Development service, so one team handles the whole project. The developers work from the approved design system, which keeps the live site faithful to the prototype you signed off. If you already have a developer, we can hand the files to them instead.

faqs.q: What Do I Need to Provide?
faqs.a: Your logo, any brand colours you already use and a few examples of websites you like are a great start. If you have photos, written content or a list of services, send those too. We guide you through everything else during the discovery workshop, so you do not need a detailed brief.

The Starter package includes two revision rounds and the Business package includes three. Premium includes unlimited revisions for 30 days. Because we agree wireframes before visual design, most feedback is about refinements rather than starting again, so the included rounds are usually enough to reach sign-off.

faqs.q: Will My Website Work on Mobile Phones?
faqs.a: Yes. Every package includes mobile versions of the pages we design, and the Business package adds tablet layouts. We design with thumbs and small screens in mind, so menus, buttons and forms remain easy to use whether visitors are on a phone, a tablet or a desktop.

faqs.q: Do You Only Work With Wolverhampton Businesses?
faqs.a: No. We are based in Wolverhampton and enjoy meeting local clients, but we design websites for businesses across Birmingham, Walsall, Dudley, Telford and the wider UK. Workshops and reviews run smoothly over video calls, and the clickable prototype means you can review designs from anywhere.

cta.p: Tell us about your business and the website you have in mind. Call +44 7445 652671 or email info@digiranxpro.com, Monday to Friday from 8am to 10pm, and we will suggest the right package and next steps.
